preconditions.description: The input root node must exist.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= node.val <= 10**4 for node in [root] + [child for node in [root] if node.left] + [child for node in [root] if node.right])
preconditions.description: Each node's candy count is a non-negative integer up to 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(node.left is None or node.left.val >= 0 for node in [root] + [child for node in [root] if node.left] + [child for node in [root] if node.right])
preconditions.description: Left child nodes exist only if explicitly assigned.

preconditions.expression: all(node.right is None or node.right.val >= 0 for node in [root] + [child for node in [root] if node.left] + [child for node in [root] if node.right])
preconditions.description: Right child nodes exist only if explicitly assigned.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(abs(node.val - 1) for node in [root] + [child for node in [root] if node.left] + [child for node in [root] if node.right]) // 2
postconditions.description: The returned value is half the sum of absolute differences between each node's candy count and the target value of 1, representing the minimal moves required to distribute exactly one candy per node.
